onboardingScenes.title: A HALL THAT STILL ANSWERS
onboardingScenes.narration: The Ruined Annex is drafty, undersupplied, and still standing. Every empty room is a promise the Guild has not yet earned.
onboardingScenes.guildmasterLine: We do not need a perfect Hall today. We need one that can keep people alive tomorrow.
onboardingScenes.instruction: Inspect the Hall, then open the Applicant Board. Normal preparation and social scenes do not consume an operation.

onboardingScenes.title: PEOPLE BEFORE NUMBERS
onboardingScenes.narration: Applicants arrive with incomplete records, practical needs, and reasons for taking dangerous work. The Guild sees what scouting can honestly establish—nothing more.
onboardingScenes.guildmasterLine: We are choosing who we can support, not buying a rarity color.
onboardingScenes.instruction: Open dossiers, compare observed strengths, and sign one recruit. Signed normal recruits remain permanent members.

onboardingScenes.title: THE FIRST VISIBLE REPAIR
onboardingScenes.narration: The settlement will believe in the Guild when it can point to something repaired, staffed, and useful.
onboardingScenes.guildmasterLine: Pick the first facility for what it lets us do—not for a hidden timer.
onboardingScenes.instruction: Claim an available plot, place a facility, and assign staff. Small construction completes immediately.
onboardingScenes.completion: Place and staff the first facility.

onboardingScenes.title: BUILD THE PEOPLE, THEN THE UNION
onboardingScenes.narration: Equipment, formation, leadership, relationships, and learned Arts determine what a Union can responsibly attempt.
onboardingScenes.guildmasterLine: A strong Union is not five isolated builds. It is five people whose strengths survive contact with the same problem.
onboardingScenes.instruction: Equip the roster manually and prepare two legal Unions. Individual Arts remain predictions inside complete Forecasts.

onboardingScenes.title: CHOOSE A RESPONSIBILITY
onboardingScenes.narration: A contract is a civic promise with a route, a risk, and people who pay the price when the Guild fails.
onboardingScenes.guildmasterLine: Read the failure and retreat terms before the reward line.
onboardingScenes.instruction: Compare the three opening contracts and commit one. The accepted board and seed cannot reroll.

onboardingScenes.title: PREPARE FOR THE ROUTE, NOT ONLY THE FIGHT
onboardingScenes.narration: A medic, scout, engineer, reserve, supply choice, or stable relationship can matter before the first enemy is visible.
onboardingScenes.guildmasterLine: The board decides what condition reaches the battle.
onboardingScenes.instruction: Review supplies, fatigue, skills, healing, Guard, scouting, and objective warnings before deployment.

onboardingScenes.title: THE ROAD IS THE DECISION
onboardingScenes.narration: Routes trade urgency, supplies, fatigue, information, optional work, and tactical advantage. Movement is committed before it is shown as resolved.
onboardingScenes.guildmasterLine: There is no perfect route. There is only the route whose cost we understand.
onboardingScenes.instruction: Choose a branch, resolve required nodes, and save after every committed movement.
onboardingScenes.completion: Reach the first camp or encounter.

onboardingScenes.title: WHO ACTS MATTERS
onboardingScenes.narration: A check belongs to the recruit who steps forward, the assistant who supports them, and the conditions the Guild created before the roll.
onboardingScenes.guildmasterLine: Commit the person and the risk. Reloading does not change what happened.
onboardingScenes.instruction: Choose an actor and assistant, then commit the deterministic 2d6 check.
onboardingScenes.completion: Resolve one event or skill check.

onboardingScenes.title: THE BOARD BECOMES THE BATTLE
onboardingScenes.narration: The expedition freezes at the exact node. Supplies, fatigue, scouting, objectives, and route consequences enter the certified Union arena through one persisted request.
onboardingScenes.guildmasterLine: Command the Union. Do not micromanage the person.
onboardingScenes.instruction: Select complete contextual Union Forecasts and finish the encounter.
onboardingScenes.completion: Return to the exact expedition node.

onboardingScenes.title: EVERY RESULT HAS A HOME
onboardingScenes.narration: Growth belongs to characters and Arts. Equipment belongs to Guild inventory. Civic progress belongs to the settlement. Nothing should vanish into one generic reward number.
onboardingScenes.guildmasterLine: Claim once. Equip by choice. Build with what the operation changed.
onboardingScenes.instruction: Review progression, claim the committed reward, and equip manually if desired.
onboardingScenes.completion: Apply the exact-once reward and return to the Hall.

onboardingScenes.title: MEMORIES, NOT MAINTENANCE
onboardingScenes.narration: Relationships grow because members protected, healed, argued, failed, recovered, trained, or worked together—not because the Guildmaster sacrificed an empty day.
onboardingScenes.guildmasterLine: The scene can wait. The memory will not disappear.
onboardingScenes.instruction: View or defer one free Hall scene. It consumes no operation and carries no penalty.
onboardingScenes.completion: View or safely defer a relationship scene.

onboardingScenes.title: A CITY BEGINS TO CHOOSE
onboardingScenes.narration: The second building or upgrade creates the first real district decision. Adjacency is useful, but no single layout is mandatory.
onboardingScenes.guildmasterLine: Make the settlement better at the work you actually ask it to do.
onboardingScenes.instruction: Place a second facility or upgrade the first, then activate one adjacency or district bonus.
onboardingScenes.completion: Save, close, relaunch, and verify the exact city state.

contractArcs.sponsorLine: A bell with no rope is ringing beneath the Hall. Kael holds the breach while a Lantern Road patrol and Skyhome's Wayglass remain missing at the old Gatehouse.
contractArcs.guildmasterPrompt: Bring the patrol home, recover the Wayglass, and stop whatever is moving through the Gatehouse toward Skyhome.
contractArcs.deploymentLine: Bring engineering for the broken road, medicine for the patrol, and Unions able to hold a collapsing line together.
contractArcs.battleBriefingLine: The missing patrol is guarding the Wayglass inside the engagement zone. Break the Gatehouse threat without cutting off their road home.
contractArcs.victoryLine: The Gatehouse threat falls. The patrol carries the recovered Wayglass onto Lantern Road and joins the Guild for the walk home.
contractArcs.mixedLine: The patrol and Wayglass return, but Lantern Road bears the cost in injuries, supplies, and unfinished Gatehouse work.
contractArcs.retreatLine: The Guild preserves the patrol members already reached and withdraws along Lantern Road. The Wayglass remains an active rescue obligation.
contractArcs.failureLine: The old Gatehouse closes around the Wayglass signal. Skyhome records the route, the missing patrol, and the threat still moving toward the city.
contractArcs.cityConsequenceLine: The rescued patrol joins the Guild, while the recovered Wayglass reveals a route pointing inside Skyhome.

contractArcs.sponsorLine: The recovered Wayglass does not point beyond Skyhome. It draws a road beneath the Guild Hall to a door no city map records.
contractArcs.guildmasterPrompt: Follow the impossible marks, find the survey crew sent below, and locate the door inside Skyhome.
contractArcs.deploymentLine: Scouting, perception, careful Mystics, and a calm leader matter more than raw speed.
contractArcs.battleBriefingLine: The enemy has been using survey information to shape the approach. Recovered evidence can expose or reverse that advantage.
contractArcs.victoryLine: The survey crew returns, the impossible marks are translated, and the Wayglass reveals the threshold of the Door Inside.
contractArcs.mixedLine: Enough of the Wayglass route is mapped to prevent another disappearance, but the door and part of the survey crew remain unresolved.
contractArcs.retreatLine: The Guild preserves what it learned and withdraws before the route beneath Skyhome closes. The Door Inside remains marked on the Wayglass.
contractArcs.failureLine: The impossible route remains open on the Wayglass and deadly beneath the city. The Door Inside waits without a trusted path.
contractArcs.cityConsequenceLine: Opening the impossible route turns the Wayglass table into Skyhome's map for Chapter 2.

contractArcs.sponsorLine: The wagons carry medicine, tools, and food. The outer wards cannot eat a promise that arrives tomorrow.
contractArcs.guildmasterPrompt: Protect the convoy, repair what the route allows, and do not spend the cargo to save the schedule.
contractArcs.deploymentLine: Guard, engineering, logistics, and ranged control will decide how much of the convoy reaches the wards.
contractArcs.battleBriefingLine: Wagons and civilians remain part of the objective. Repeated interference changes which Union must hold, escort, or counterattack.
contractArcs.victoryLine: The first wagon reaches the ward gate before the lanterns are lit. The road becomes a route again instead of a warning.
contractArcs.mixedLine: Part of the convoy arrives. The city gains a functioning relief line, but the missing cargo shapes the next operation.
contractArcs.retreatLine: The surviving wagons turn back under Guard. The shipment is diminished, but the Guild does not abandon the people pulling it.
contractArcs.failureLine: The convoy breaks and the outer wards ration what remains. The road stays open only on the map.
contractArcs.cityConsequenceLine: Successful delivery strengthens Market, Warehouse, Supply Depot, and civic trust progression.

relationshipScenes.title: The Map Between Them

relationshipScenes.title: What We Carry Back

relationshipScenes.secondLine: “Then help me make the next one better.”
relationshipScenes.closing: Failure can deepen identity without causing departure.

relationshipScenes.title: After the Noise Stops

relationshipScenes.title: Recovery Is Work
relationshipScenes.setup: Two members meet while one is recovering and the other is assigned to help.
relationshipScenes.firstLine: “I hate being the person everyone waits for.”
relationshipScenes.secondLine: “Then recover for the people who are not asking you to rush.”
relationshipScenes.closing: Injury creates a playable recovery path, not permanent loss.

relationshipScenes.title: The Route No One Saw
relationshipScenes.setup: A scout explains why they withheld certainty instead of selling confidence.
relationshipScenes.closing: Honest uncertainty becomes a leadership memory.

relationshipScenes.title: A Roof With Their Names Under It
relationshipScenes.setup: Members watch the first completed facility take shape around the old Hall.
relationshipScenes.secondLine: “That means we can build the next thing.”
relationshipScenes.closing: City progress becomes a shared institutional memory.

relationshipScenes.title: Permission Before Possession
relationshipScenes.setup: A recruit asks for equipment without taking control away from the player.
relationshipScenes.firstLine: “May I try it on the next operation?”
relationshipScenes.secondLine: “Ask again after we compare the full loadout.”
relationshipScenes.closing: Equipment requests create dialogue while ownership remains explicit.

outcomeEpilogues.narration: The Gatehouse threat falls. The patrol carries the recovered Wayglass onto Lantern Road and joins the Guild for the walk home.
outcomeEpilogues.cityConsequence: The rescued patrol joins the Guild, while the recovered Wayglass reveals a route pointing inside Skyhome.

outcomeEpilogues.narration: The patrol and Wayglass return, but Lantern Road bears the cost in injuries, supplies, and unfinished Gatehouse work.
outcomeEpilogues.cityConsequence: The rescued patrol joins the Guild, while the recovered Wayglass reveals a route pointing inside Skyhome.

outcomeEpilogues.narration: The Guild preserves the patrol members already reached and withdraws along Lantern Road. The Wayglass remains an active rescue obligation.

outcomeEpilogues.narration: The old Gatehouse closes around the Wayglass signal. Skyhome records the route, the missing patrol, and the threat still moving toward the city.
